dataset_name: Raphael Supply Chain & Materials Decision Platform

provenance.demand: Walmart M5 benchmark data relabelled as materials
provenance.disclaimer: Demand series reflect retail benchmark patterns relabelled as materials; lead times and current inventory are synthetic.

model_architecture.demand_models: Production model: Weekday Mean 8W across all 75 pairs (per-pair selection discarded because it failed to generalize to held-out test window)
model_architecture.lead_time_model: Random Forest Regressor with 5-fold out-of-fold empirical uncertainty calibration and extrapolation boundaries
model_architecture.decision_engine: Pure arithmetic safety stock, reorder point, EOQ, and day-by-day forecast depletion (no machine learning in decisions)
model_architecture.promotion_simulation: Simulated, empirical lift: weekday-adjusted historical lift with 500-iteration bootstrap confidence intervals
